sentences.text: Tingitanius was a member of the class Chondrichthyes, a group that includes cartilaginous fish.
It is classified as an extinct genus within the family Platyrhinidae.
The genus Tingitanius was described by Claeson and colleagues in 2013.
Fossils of Tingitanius tenuimandibulus have been found in the Akrabou Formation in Morocco.
Tingitanius tenuimandibulus is the type species for the genus Tingitanius.
This animal lived during the Turonian stage of the Late Cretaceous epoch.
The species existed between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
